metadata.name: Seongnam OSM landcover extract
metadata.processing: Original full-resolution WGS84 rings, multipolygon holes and raw tags. Keep only complete areas inside exact municipal boundary; same-class outer member ways deduplicated. No terrain or canopy height inferred.
limitations: OSM landcover is incomplete and is not an official land survey.
Areas that cross the municipal boundary are excluded to preserve original outlines, including some large forests and river sections.
Invalid, open or unresolved polygon topology is excluded and logged.
Leisure park extents, grass, woodland and water may overlap semantically; these are independent mapped classifications.
Missing tree nodes, canopy coverage, elevation and surface material are not invented.
Layer acquisition is separate from the earlier roads, buildings and POIs snapshot.
